item.title: Pottawatomie County Junior Livestock show begins Tuesday
item.description: The annual Pottawatomie County Junior Livestock Show kicks off today at the Expo Center.

item.title: McLoud takes care of business by sweeping district from Tecumseh
item.description: McLOUD - Both Tecumseh teams took early leads over McLoud, but both gave up big runs that allowed McLoud to take two easy wins.

item.title: Legislative session briefs and updates
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY – Two measures by Rep. Kevin Norwood, R-Owasso, aimed at strengthening Oklahoma’s crisis response systems, have advanced in the legislative process.

item.title: Bethel girls blast Lexington; Wildcats fall to Community Christian
item.description: BETHEL ACRES – The Class 3A 13th-ranked Bethel Lady Wildcats forced 34 turnovers while racking up 20 steals in the process Friday night in smacking the Lexington Lady Bulldogs 65-19 for a Class 3A district championship at the B.E. Cantrell Fieldhouse.

item.title: Pottawatomie County Junior Livestock show begins today
item.description: Area youth who have been caring for their animals and preparing for the moment are in the show ring this week at the Expo Center for the annual Pottawatomie County Junior Livestock Show.

item.title: Making a difference: Tri-County Changemakers
item.description: The Tri-County area is fortunate to have people who always seem to be there for others when they’re needed the most – those who often go above and beyond to make the community a better place and spark positive change. Many make a genuine difference by giving of their time, energy and talents for the betterment of the community and all those who call Tri-County home.

item.title: 'From Concepts to Canvas' art talk to feature Oklahoma artist Lucas Simmons in Shawnee Hall
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist University will host “From Concept to Canvas,” an art talk featuring artist and OBU alumnus Lucas Simmons at 4 p.m. Thursday, March 5, in Mabee Lecture Theatre on the third floor of Shawnee Hall.
